name: Fractal Analytics Ltd
title: Fractal Analytics Ltd - 544700 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Fractal grew FY26 revenue 19% (13% constant currency) with 22% Q4 adjusted EBITDA, but TMT client losses masked a 27% ex-TMT growth; no numeric FY27 revenue guidance was given.

triggers.label: No numeric FY27 revenue guidance
triggers.quote: We do not have specific revenue guidance at this point in time

triggers.label: Q4 margin helped by one-offs
triggers.quote: These two items improved adjusted EBITDA by 147 bps in Q4 2026.

guidance.value: historical growth rates a good indication
guidance.quote: we expect that our historical revenue growth rates are a good indication of where we should be growing in the next year as well.
We want to take that license driven revenue from 3% to 20% by 2030

red_flags.label: TMT client losses and data delays
red_flags.quote: we were not able to recognize some revenue because of some data-led delays.

red_flags.label: Q4 margin aided by grant and bonus reversal
red_flags.quote: These two items improved adjusted EBITDA by 147 bps in Q4 2026. Some of these benefits may or may not repeat
